subject.title: feat(sessions): show preambles as live subtitles

question: Should safe native-runtime preambles become the default immediate subtitle for active sessions, with richer utility-model assessments allowed to replace them later?
rationale: The patch introduces a default cross-client progress surface, and the existing related issue intentionally distinguishes this safe subtitle from a broader visible-progress product direction.

options.title: Adopt the scoped subtitle behavior
options.body: Keep the observer-digest design and require direct Codex-contract inspection plus redacted real-client proof before merge.

options.title: Keep it optional or deferred
options.body: Do not change the default session subtitle until the broader progress-panel direction is decided in the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Adopt the scoped subtitle behavior
recommendation.body: Keep the observer-digest design and require direct Codex-contract inspection plus redacted real-client proof before merge.
